arxiv-2302-03840.title: MMPD: Multi-Domain Mobile Video Physiology Dataset
arxiv-2302-03840.creator: Jiankai Tang, Kequan Chen, Yuntao Wang, Yuanchun Shi, Shwetak Patel, Daniel McDuff, Xin Liu, ∗ * Corresponding Author
arxiv-2302-03840.description: Abstract Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is an attractive method for noninvasive, convenient and concomitant measurement of physiological vital signals. Public benchmark datasets have served a valuable role in the development of this technology and improvements in accuracy over recent years. However, there remain gaps in the public datasets.

arxiv-2308-08568.title: Gas in external fields: the weird case of the logarithmic trap
arxiv-2308-08568.creator: Loris Ferrari
arxiv-2308-08568.description: Abstract The effects of an attractive logarithmic potential u 0 ​ ln ⁡ ( r / r 0 ) u_{0}\ln(r/r_{0}) on a gas of N N non interacting particles (Bosons or Fermions), in a box of volume V D V_{D} , are studied in D = 2 , 3 D=2,\>3 dimensions.

arxiv-2401-13364.title: Echeloned saturation and forcing axioms
arxiv-2401-13364.creator: Shimon Garti
arxiv-2401-13364.description: Abstract . We show that under the failure of Chang’s conjecture and the assumption that Martin’s axiom holds and the continuum is above ω 2 \omega_{2} there are no weakly Laver ideals over ℵ 1 \aleph_{1} . This gives an answer to a question of Paul Larson.

arxiv-2402-15552.title: Morphological symmetries in robotics
arxiv-2402-15552.creator: Daniel Ordoñez Apraez \affilnum 1,2, Giulio Turrisi \affilnum 1, Vladimir Kostic \affilnum 2, Mario Martin \affilnum 3, Antonio Agudo \affilnum 3, Francesc Moreno-Noguer \affilnum 3, Massimiliano Pontil \affilnum 2, Claudio Semini \affilnum 1, and Carlos Mastalli \affilnum 4,5
arxiv-2402-15552.description: Abstract We present a comprehensive framework for studying and leveraging morphological symmetries in robotic systems. These are intrinsic properties of the robot’s morphology, frequently observed in animal biology and robotics, which stem from the replication of kinematic structures and the symmetrical distribution of mass.

arxiv-2411-06347.title: Classification in Japanese Sign Language Based on Dynamic Facial Expressions
arxiv-2411-06347.creator: Yui Tatsumi, Shoko Tanaka, Shunsuke Akamatsu, Takahiro Shindo, Hiroshi Watanabe
arxiv-2411-06347.description: Abstract Sign language is a visual language expressed through hand movements and non-manual markers. Non-manual markers include facial expressions and head movements. These expressions vary across different nations. Therefore, specialized analysis methods for each sign language are necessary. However, research on Japanese Sign Language (JSL) recognition is limited due to a lack of datasets.

arxiv-2506-10576.title: Harmonizing Geometry and Uncertainty: Diffusion with Hyperspheres
arxiv-2506-10576.creator: Muskan Dosi, Chiranjeev Chiranjeev, Kartik Thakral, Mayank Vatsa, Richa Singh
arxiv-2506-10576.description: Abstract Do contemporary diffusion models preserve the class geometry of hyperspherical data? Standard diffusion models rely on isotropic Gaussian noise in the forward process, inherently favoring Euclidean spaces. However, many real-world problems involve non-Euclidean distributions, such as hyperspherical manifolds, where class-specific patterns are governed by angular geometry within hypercones.

arxiv-2508-08939.title: MADPromptS: Unlocking Zero-Shot Morphing Attack Detection with Multiple Prompt Aggregation Conference: Proceedings of the 1st International Workshop & Challenge on Subtle Visual Computing; October 27–28, 2025; Dublin, Ireland Proceedings of the 1st International Workshop & Challenge on Subtle Visual
arxiv-2508-08939.creator: Eduarda Caldeira, Fadi Boutros, Naser Damer
arxiv-2508-08939.description: Abstract . Face Morphing Attack Detection (MAD) is a critical challenge in face recognition security, where attackers can fool systems by interpolating the identity information of two or more individuals into a single face image, resulting in samples that can be verified as belonging to multiple identities by face recognition systems.

arxiv-2510-04583.title: Improved probabilistic regression using diffusion models
arxiv-2510-04583.creator: Carlo Kneissl, Christopher Bülte, Philipp SchollLudwig-Maximilians-Universität MünchenMunich Center for Machine Learning (MCML)Munich, Germany {kneissl, buelte, scholl}@math.lmu.de Gitta KutyniokLudwig-Maximilians-Universität MünchenUniversity of TromsøDLR-German Aerospace CenterMunich Center for Ma
arxiv-2510-04583.description: Abstract Probabilistic regression models the entire predictive distribution of a response variable, offering richer insights than classical point estimates and directly allowing for uncertainty quantification. While diffusion-based generative models have shown remarkable success in generating complex, high-dimensional data, their usage in general regression tasks often lacks uncertainty-related evaluation and remains limited to domain-specific applications.

arxiv-2601-20135.title: Control systems for synthetic biology and a case-study in cell fate reprogramming
arxiv-2601-20135.creator: Domitilla Del Vecchio
arxiv-2601-20135.description: Abstract Summary. This paper gives an overview of the use of control systems engineering in synthetic biology, motivated by applications such as cell therapy and cell fate reprogramming for regenerative medicine. A ubiquitous problem in these and other applications is the ability to control the concentration of specific regulatory factors in the cell accurately despite environmental uncertainty and perturbations.

arxiv-2601-21143.title: Electric birefringence in Euler-Heisenberg pseudo-electrodynamics
arxiv-2601-21143.creator: M. J. Neves
arxiv-2601-21143.description: Abstract The fermion sector of the pseudo-quantum electrodynamics is integrated functionally to generate a non-linear electrodynamics, that it is called Euler-Heisenberg pseudo-electrodynamics. A non-local Chern-Simons topological term is added to the original lagrangian of the pseudo-quantum electrodynamics in which a most complete electrodynamics gauge invariant in 1+2 dimensions is proposed.

arxiv-2605-07002.title: Adaptive auditing of AI systems with anytime-valid guarantees
arxiv-2605-07002.creator: Siyu Zhou Patrick Vossler Venkatesh Sivaraman Yifan Mai Jean Feng

pmc-11455043.title: 8817 IGF-II Regulates Magmas A Mitochondrial Protein Required For Cell Viability And ROS Protection
pmc-11455043.creator: Katherine Granados, Alfonso Durán, Frankis Almaguel, Daisy De Leon
pmc-11455043.description: Disclosure: K. Granados: None. A. Durán: None. F. Almaguel: None. D. De Leon: None.Our laboratory previously showed that Insulin-like growth factor II (IGF-II) promotes cell proliferation, inhibits apoptosis and induces chemoresistance of Breast Cancer (BC) cells. We demonstrated that IGF-II achieves this by inhibiting pro-apoptotic proteins and stimulating anti-apoptotic proteins.

pmc-12515308.title: Immune-mediated extraocular myositis in an adolescent following coronavirus disease 2019: A case report
pmc-12515308.creator: Yixiang Wu, Xiao Chen, Zheng Fan, Mingyu Ren
pmc-12515308.description: A wide spectrum of ocular manifestations have been documented in patients following infection with severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2). Nevertheless, bilateral extraocular myositis specifically associated with natural SARS-CoV-2 infection has been rarely reported. We report the case of an East Asian adolescent female who presented with right ocular discomfort and diminished visual acuity for 2 weeks.

pmc-12540005.title: Chronic Kidney Disease in Pediatric Recipients of Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation in a 5-Year Observation—A Single Center Experience
pmc-12540005.creator: Katarzyna Gąsowska, Katarzyna Zachwieja, Monika Miklaszewska, Aleksandra Krasowska-Kwiecień, Jolanta Goździk, Dorota Drożdż
pmc-12540005.description: BackgroundChronic kidney disease (CKD) is a common complication of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT). However, the data on its risk factors in the pediatric population is conflicting.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed data from HSCT patients treated between 2005 and 2019, including indications for HSCT, conditioning regimens, and complications observed during a 5-year follow-up period, and calculated estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) values.

pmc-12586872.title: Defining and Measuring the Goldilocks Zone in Healthcare: A Review of Metrics and Models
pmc-12586872.creator: Hannah Yu Kit Lee, Chun En Yau, Kevin Xiang Zhou, Jason Chin Huat Yap, Isaac Kah Siang Ng, Qin Xiang Ng
pmc-12586872.description: The “Goldilocks Zone”, a term borrowed from astrophysics, describes the optimal range where conditions are just right to support life. In healthcare, this metaphor captures the imperative to balance underuse and overuse of medical services, ensuring care is neither excessive nor insufficient but instead maximally effective, equitable, and sustainable.

pmc-12595102.title: Mechanical characteristics and partition control technology in whole life cycle of deep gob-side entry: A case study
pmc-12595102.creator: Hua Bian, Jian Hao, Jiaqing Lv, Lijin Zhao
pmc-12595102.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In deep mining engineering, high-stress roadways frequently experience severe damage, thereby compromising the stability of the surrounding rock. This study investigates the stress-energy evolution in the 31,402 material roadway in Hongqinghe Coal Mine through numerical simulation and field measurement. The study focuses on three critical stages of its whole life cycle: facing the excavation roadway, gob-side entry driving, and mining of the working face. The mechanical behavior of each stage shows significant differences.

pmc-12641454.title: Mapping Resting‐State Brain Functional Specialization to Neurotransmitter Profiles in Autism Spectrum Disorder
pmc-12641454.creator: Dafa Shi, Jitian Guan, Guangsong Wang, Shuohua Wu, Caiyu Zhuang, Yumeng Mao, Yanlong Jia, Nannan Zhao, Gen Yan, Renhua Wu
pmc-12641454.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAutism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a highly prevalent neurodevelopmental disorder. However, its diagnosis and effective treatment present challenges. Understanding neurotransmitter impairments may offer new perspectives into the mechanisms underlying ASD and the potential therapeutic targets for this condition.

pmc-12697170.title: Complete genome sequence of Pediococcus pentosaceus TOKAI 759m, a promising soy milk yogurt starter isolated from rice in Japan
pmc-12697170.creator: Tomoyuki Hibi, Takahiro Kawanabe, Yuki Nakashima, Shin Yasuda, Masashi Hirano, Hideki Kinoshita
pmc-12697170.description: Pediococcus pentosaceus TOKAI 759m is a Gram-positive bacterium isolated from rice in Japan. Our previous study demonstrated that this strain is a promising starter culture for soy milk yogurt due to its various beneficial properties. The strain has been commercialized. In this study, we present the complete genome sequence of this strain.

pmc-13088403.title: A case of trigeminal nerve neurosarcoidosis initially presenting with isolated neurological findings mimicking trigeminal schwannoma: a case report and review of the literature
pmc-13088403.creator: Ahmed Msherghi, Ceylan Altintas Taslicay, Heba Al Qudah, Hamza A. Salim, Sahar Alizada, Muhammed Elhadi, Max Wintermark, Maria Gule-Monroe
pmc-13088403.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSarcoidosis is a granulomatous inflammatory disease primarily affecting the lungs. Central nervous system involvement is rare, occurring in approximately 5–10% of cases. Isolated lesions of the cranial nerve, particularly affecting the trigeminal nerve, are even less common.

pmc-13556595.title: 736. A Youth–Adult Partnership Mental Health Literacy Intervention Led by Medical Students for Hong Kong Adolescents: A School-Based Mixed-Methods Evaluation
pmc-13556595.creator: HK Y Lo, C Kwok, N S Xu, X L Tsoi, CC Y Hui, PT Y Yuen, AW C Cheng, W L Chu, VW C Lau, R Wong, A Li, S M Yau, A Hau, J Chen
pmc-13556595.description: BackgroundYouth aged 15–24 years represent a critical developmental window for the onset of mental disorders, yet symptoms are frequently unrecognised and untreated. Mental disorders contribute substantially to the global disease burden in this age group, including depression and suicidality. . Mental health literacy is a modifiable determinant of stigma, symptom recognition, and help-seeking.
